description: The union of a nonempty family of Dedekind cuts bounded above by a cut is itself a cut and is their least upper bound under inclusion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.cut_union_lub (F : Set Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.Cut)
  (hne : F.Nonempty) (hb : ∃ U, ∀ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ↑U) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.IsCut (⋃ A ∈ F, ↑A) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ⋃ B ∈ F, ↑B) ∧
      ∀ (U : Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.Cut), (∀ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ↑U) → ⋃ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ↑U
